name: Saddle Finance
fix_description: In _calculateSwap (MetaSwapUtils library), multiply the LP token balance by virtualPrice before computing the swap output, consistent with how _calculateSwapUnderlying handles it. This is the same vulnerability as Nerve Bridge (Saddle fork).
difficulty_reasoning: This is a flash-loan-based, multi-contract exploit involving Euler, Curve, and Saddle, so an auditor must understand protocol-specific swap paths and why the round-trip through Saddle is profitable. The PoC is still fairly short and only a few steps, but it is beyond an obvious single-bug pattern and requires some DeFi pool/accounting analysis.
